text:
marta: Quick note — ran into a streamer hang in the Go generator example while testing token rotation in the sample app. Next() blocked even after ctx canceled.

jin: repro steps?

marta: Start stream with short timeout, trigger a credential rotation mid-stream (we use a fake STS in sampleapp), the client-side refresh HTTP request hangs and Next() never returns.

rob: can you drop the minimal snippet you used?

marta: sure:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 150*time.Millisecond)
defer cancel()
iter, err := client.Generator.Stream(ctx, req)
if err != nil {
  log.Fatal(err)
}
for iter.Next() {
  fmt.Println(iter.Event())
}
if err := iter.Err(); err != nil {
  log.Println("stream error:", err)
}
```
The loop waits on a chan read that only the internal handshake goroutine writes to. That goroutine blocks on the refresh HTTP call and doesn't observe ctx.Done().

claire: sounds like two problems: (1) refresh uses default HTTP client without request context, (2) iterator lacks a Close/Stop API.

jin: agree. For short-term sampleapp fix: make the refresh transport attach the original ctx to the refresh request and set a per-call timeout. For medium-term: expose Iterator.Stop() and ensure all internal goroutines use a cancelable child ctx.

rob: do we also want to add a retry/backoff change? If refresh retries indefinitely it will exacerbate the hang.

marta: yes limit retries when ctx canceled. We should check runtime code that retries auth on 5xx vs network errors and ensure it bails if ctx.Done().

infra-bot: CI pipeline triggered for branch marta/stream-auth-stall-fix (build queued).

claire: tests: add one that spins up a test server that sleeps on the refresh endpoint and assert that calling iter.Stop() or canceling ctx returns within N ms. Add a sampleapp example snippet showing 'defer iter.Stop()' and using WithCancel around long-running streams.

rob: API call: prefer Stop()/Close() over adding flags. Keep generator.Stream signature unchanged. Implementation detail: create iterator.ctx, iterator.cancel and close internal channels on Stop. Document behavior in Go SDK README.

marta: I'll open the two PRs: go-sdk patch (Stop + ctx-aware refresh + limited retries) and sampleapp changes (example + docs + lint note). I'll drop the test server handler code in the PR.

jin: also add a short blurb in CHANGELOG under "bugfix(go): prevent generator stream hang on auth refresh". Keep wording careful for compat.

infra-bot: build passed for marta/stream-auth-stall-fix, awaiting reviews. :white_check_mark:

marta: thanks everyone — will link PRs here when ready.
